cues.text: BUILD — set the shoreline clock
Sonic Pi: use_bpm 104 · use_random_seed 20260817 · sleep 192
HEAR — Set the kick like a lighthouse, four beats in a row
Let the snare hit the shoreline, then the low tide flows
Pick a little guitar, let the tremolo sway
Leave a gap for the ocean, let the backbeat play
Write one line, hear it ring
Change one thing, feel the spring — hear the relationship before adding more.
TWEAK — catch the wave; the chorus is a shared clock with different colors.
Code a little motion, feel it in your soul
Kick and snare, guitar in the air
Tune the voice, ride the line, surf it everywhere
Use a pluck on the guitar, spring it left to right
Short delay behind the pick makes the daylight bright
Bass can trace the root, then answer off the beat
Toms can climb the shoreline when the chorus finds its feet
LOCK — pull it back to open water; subtraction makes the return feel larger.
Bring the tremolo back in time, that's the surf you made
COMPLETE — hard-step pitch maps the sung voice to E major while the take stays musical.
Catch the wave, catch the wave, let the waveform roll
